source.name: Karoryfer Swagbass
source.recordedInstrument: Ibanez BTB-400QM, neck pickup DI, old DAddario Chrome flatwound strings; no onboard EQ or effects
source.mapping: swagbass_clean.sfz: original pitch centers, key ranges, velocity boundaries and four-take sequence

processing: Preserve each original recording up to 8 seconds, including onset and natural decay; only final 20ms safety fade; mono 44.1kHz PCM16, lossless FLAC plus bit-identical decoded WAV fallback. No per-note or per-velocity normalization, pitch shift, EQ, compression or added effects. Shared gain 0dB.
originalMidiDefault: SFZ omits pitch_keycenter for root60 groups; default is MIDI60. Retained alongside roots27..57 at three-semitone intervals.
velocityResponse: Original SFZ amp_velcurve points retained with default endpoint0=0 and127=1; regions without a custom curve use default amplitudeExponent2. Apply this response once to each recorded sample; do not multiply velocity again or normalize recorded dynamics.
